name: @slopcad/cad-consumer-minimal-fixture
description: Phase 35.4 MINIMAL external consumer fixture: installs the smallest useful registry set — one UI component (`@slopcad/cad-viewport`) and one parametric CAD component (`@slopcad/nema17-mount`, pulling the component contract/kernel/adapter items) — from the locally generated registry artifacts, builds the mount through the Manifold kernel, and renders it in the installed viewport. The registry-consumer matrix proves the install path works for a fresh minimal consumer, not just the every-category fixture.
